reviews.text: Dr. Casey and her assistants are amazing! They are incredibly informative, patient, and gentle. Wonderful experiences each time I’ve been
Very clean, friendly and caring staff, quick service and reasonable price. Highly recommend!
Awesome service. The vet is really nice. Been seeing her for a couple years now.
Great service and prices
I had such a positive experience at PetWell Clinic! The vet team is highly professional, friendly and my dog received the help she needed in a very short time frame. I am grateful for their help.
Excellent, very good care for my fur baby. So happy I found them.

Got right in to see the Dr. She was thorough and informative .
Great staff . Great Pricing
Hi, Goldie. Thank you so much for rating your experience with us so highly!
My 15yr old dog was having allergy issues and I was able to get in immediately. I rec’d quality care, explanation and felt very comfortable. my dog’s doing a lot better.
My doggy daycare referred me to this pet clinic. I was able to get in quick and they were great with my dog, who is very anxious at the vet. Pricing was reasonable.
They were absolutely fabulous with my kitten and he is so much better today.

Absolutely fantastic! I am an extremely attached "Parent" I dont like the word owner, and most vet hospitals and clinics take forever to get into or you have to just drop them off all day where your family member is stuck in a small kennel waiting for their turn even if its just a check up. Here I was greeted immediately as a walk-in, clean, friendly and welcoming. They took my information and back I went for the exam and recommended treatment. They understood my concerns and how my Lola is family and deserves the best yet at the same time THE PRICES WERE VERY AFFORDABLE. I got AAA+ service, VIP treatment and paid 1/3 the cost. Now the medications are the same as anyway else that is universal but truly, they are worth every penny and then same. THANK YOU!!

I truly appreciate the great service and the attention they gave to Tiana and Theo. It’s reassuring to know that there are people who genuinely care about our pets and their well-being. Thank you to the entire Petwell Clinic team for taking such good care of my girl! who developed a UTI and my boy who needed one vaccine🐾❤️

I highly recommend Petwell Clinic to anyone looking for compassionate and professional care for their pets!

We couldn’t be happier with the service we received from Dani and Dr. Eduardo. Dani helped communicate availability for the day and was a big help when we arrived with our pup. I highly recommend using PetWellClinic especially the one on Greenway and Tatum. Very clean. Very Organized.

Such caring people here. I have old dog, very afraid of any vet experience. Usually takes 2 people to just get her near the door & that's the easy part. After a few visits here, I asked for help getting her in,due to my broken foot. The young lady( am sorry,again I forget her name) she had helped me before when my dog was resisting at the sidewalk even. She came right to my truck & my dog walked off with her ,didn't look back for me..lol..even went in the door ,no fussing or resisting,etc. Wonderful to see dog so calm & secure w her. Thank u all at Pet Well!

Amazing amazing amazing! Exceptional medical care for my fur babies at the lowest rates in the valley. 100 bucks covered my exam AND the medication. Plus the kind Dr even went above and beyond giving me a script that was enough for my other kitty that was sick with the same thing at home. So kind and compassionate. You can really tell me that they do the job for the animals and not for the paycheck. I love that you don't need an appointment you can just walk right in and be seen with little wait. I will never go anywhere else and I can't recommend this clinic enough!!
Hi, Garry. Thank you so much for rating your experience with us so highly!
Great staff and service.
Fast. Affordable. Friendly staff.

I really love this clinic! They are so sweet and gentle with all my pups. I'm able to stay with my babies the entire time. Their prices are MUCH better than any of the other vet clinics I've compared.  I only wish that they could be open more often.
Very caring staff & great vet. Was able to get my dog seen right away. Her allergy issues were addressed & it was affordable. Highly recommend this location. Thank you PetWellClinic!
We brought our two dogs in for check up and shots. I checked online and there was no wait so we just walked in. They were so nice and we were in and out quickly. We will definitely be back
Hi, Alexandrea. Thank you so much for rating your experience with us so highly!

A few of my dogs needed blood work and updated vaccinations.  The vet doctor and staff where very friendly and through in the health examination of my dogs.  For example; most blood work cost $400 at a regular vet office and they only charged $200. The vaccination packages are a dream at $137!  They are very reasonably priced. Plus, they allowed me into the examination room.  A good experience all-around...
Staff is friendly and professional. Service was quick and affordable. Highly recommend for routine pet care.

Highly recommend this clinic! Thank you so much for taking walk-in clients, including on Saturdays — that’s incredibly helpful when something urgent comes up with your pet and you can’t wait for an appointment. We were able to come in without scheduling, and they saw us very quickly. The veterinarian was very kind, caring, and took the time to help with our issue. The staff provided great service, and the prices were also very reasonable. Really grateful for the positive experience!

Hi , my dog had to go in for a ruptured cyst, she’s also a bit reactive. We got there as soon as they opened hoping no one was there! There wasn’t 😊 they got us checked in and allowed us to wait in the medical exam room for the doctor.
Not only are they pretty upfront about pricing but it’s very reasonable. We were in and out and my bay felt so safe. Times are hard and I’m so thankful for them. 💗 I forgot my nurse and vets name but thank you guys again! 💗

Had to get shots for our dog. Kind of hate that there is an evaluation fee on top of the vaccines, but I guess that's the standard. Staff were professional and Vet was kind though. Definitely worth the convenience having this location open.

I don't give any one a 5star rating  them girls at tatum and Greenway deserve it,the doc shes right on point she started off a little timid with my rottie,and her tech she did and excellent job keeping bella distracted whiledoc performed the exam I have a hard time find good vets who will see rotties so bella was to wound up and stung on doggie treats to show any signs of pain.so doc called it a spain andsent me home with some meds and if she's not better ina coupledays  we will go back and get a referal for X-rays they arw not a full service  vet butthedo emergency  and general exams and shots and do allow walk ins emergencys  pricing was reasonable. They do take care credit. And they are close by.so I think we found a new general vet. So if you live in the belmont area I definitely recommend them... Bella got mad when we left ..
Great place to take your dog helpful staff and very knowledgeable
I give petwell a 5 stars. They were efficient, kind, and knowledgeable and very helpful. No waiting. I was very impressed. Will use them again. I highly recommend them.

I have had to run to this vet more than twice now with my yorkie baby. She’s 3 and quite the little rascal. I was greeted and promptly addressed and taken back with my dog. They have always been very sweet, kind, calm and thorough with my baby. They answered any and all questions. Helped my girl out and we were out the door and back home within 35 mins. I guess I’ve been lucky enough to not have to wait ever. I just want to thank Dr Casey and the staff for always helping me get my girl back to her normal self! Also, you can’t really beat the prices for what’s it’s worth!!! You guys are great! Thank you!!

The doctor and assistant were so kind and helpful!!! They treated my dog with so much love which helped him out greatly with his anxiousness. He went in for an allergy shot and he’s doing amazing now!! Thank you
The staff are always very kind and seem to get us in pretty quickly

Dr Casey was our vet before she sold her previous practice. We were delighted to hear she’s practicing again at PetWell Greenway. It’s a little far for us but definitely worth it! And pricing is so reasonable. Couldn’t recommend enough!!
Thank you for taking care of our boy Reagan!

My corgi had an eye infection, and instead of paying his normal vet $250 not including the medication. I was glad I found pet well clinic, as it had no line and affordable! She gave us the medicine after the exam right away! He’s already back to normal after 2 days. Thank you!

I can't imagine better care for my little Freya than that provided at PetWellClinic. Excellent clinical results with my puppy. I wholeheartedly and sincerely recommend this clinic, as caring for our puppies is essential 🙏🏻 …

UPDATE: I've since been back twice when our regular vet could not see us. Same great experience!

My regular vet was closed and I decided to try PetWell Clinic for an emergency with my senior Chihuahua. We arrived about an hour before their closing time and were seen right away. Both the vet and staff were terrific. Cost was also very reasonable - so glad I tried them instead of heading to the emergency vet!

The bedside manners here are completely lacking. My Boxer, Bailey has been treated here since we moved to AZ 2 years ago. Last week I called because I feared it was time to help her over the bridge. I explained that this was my first time having to make this decision and just needed to know what to look for. Like a quality of life scale or something of that nature.  I get a call back from the vet tech not even one of the vets who let me know they played my tearful voicemail for everyone but couldn’t give medical advice over the phone and offered to let me bring her in for tests. I explained that I wasn’t looking for medical advice yet and was just looking for some kind of rubric on quality of life to know if bringing her in was worth it. They couldn’t help. I called another local vet who also let me know they couldn’t give medical advice over the phone but offered to email me some trustworthy sites that might help ME make the decision and that’s all I was looking for. A trusted source from ppl who treated her. I ultimately decided to send her over the bridge and had her ashes delivered here.

Yesterday I went to pick them up, they called and not even a condolences was given. It was enough to ensure I never bring another dog here.

The quality of care I’d been receiving here has significantly gone down. Literally the communication everytime I brought one of my dogs here recently has been abhorrent in not explaining potential side effects and more recently not acknowledging that a particular vet tech was not a fit for my dog. He came in with a stomach ache and was fine with the vet but snapped on the vet tech and had to be muzzled. I explained that that has never happened before and that I also got bad vibes from this vet tech upon walking in. She was rude and cold upon entry and they brushed it off as him feeling sick and said that I was making the tech feel bad instead of acknowledging that some vets and vet techs simply aren’t a fit. He’s been sick before and has never snapped at anyone including their vet.

The lack of humanity was the final straw for me. If you call someone to pick up ashes for their late pet, the least you can offer is condolences.

I could go into detail about how my Bailey was treated but that’s a long story and she’s gone now so I’ll leave at this. If you’re looking for humanity and care, this isn’t your place.

RIP Bailey. Your mama had your back until the very end and am so glad I didn’t bring you in for another pointless test or expense.
Hi, Heidy. Thank you so much for rating your experience with us so highly!

DO NOT GO HERE! The schedule is based around the one vet that is there around her kids sports schedule. You can't call them. If you text/email them it goes to ANY one of their clinics and all information gets lost in translation. My cat was overdosed on medication because of their miscommunication between clinics. They don't euthanize there due to what they say is their "esthetic" lay out. The vet herself missed so things wrong with my cat that I ended up having to put down my cat somewhere else. They don't do any in house blood work or labs. Go to LOVET down the road from there. LOVET is amazing! STAY AWAY FROM THIS PLACE!
Awesome place, thanks for helping my fur baby cheap and treating us with respect and compassion JACKY 💟 SAYS THANKS🐶🐶

The Dr was amazing with my puppy! And the woman that helped me at the front desk was also so great, informative and welcoming. My puppy loved both of them and didn't even know that she got a shot! I loved everything about this experience and highly recommend them!!

Got right in and was really pleased with how kind Dr. Casey was with my dog and took the time to talk with me.  Also, prices were way better than anywhere I've been!  I will only be using them from now on.  Thank you
Easy in, easy out, fair prices and great care! Dr. Casey is amazing!
Very professional!  Great Vet!!
The staff was so nice and the Vet was very thorough. J will definitely be taking my pet there if I can’t get into our normal vet. Pricing is also affordable.

Great staff rate prices in great convenience. I’m part of a  501(c) rescue and I take a lot of my cats there due to the convenience in the great pricing. I highly recommend this place for most of your Veterinary needs

Hi I came in yesterday with my puppy yoda he had swollen ears and I just want to say thank you so much to your team for the kindness you showed me and yoda i appreciate the affordable care the speed in which he was treated I had a great overall review it’s only been one day and his ears are much better I will most definitely be using this service again I highly recommend this place of business thank you all so much again

Amazing experience! This clinic has an online feature that lets you register your pet and see who's in line and get in queue. When I arrived I had to trouble finding it and there was plenty of parking. The place is a maculate. I could almost see my reflection on the floor. The staff were very kind and welcoming. I waited for just a few minutes before going back into the exam room. The nurse and the doctor were excellent I could tell they were really listening to what I said instead of just absently nodding ignoring me and charging me hundreds of dollars for meds that don't work, like other places I've been. I couldnt be more happier with my experience here. They heard me, did the exam, told me what they thought we should do and explained it all to me. I agreed and they brought me the payment machine and the medication and I was on my way the whole exam was 15 min and the best part the exam was only $65 and the meds my cat needed were only like $25 so for all that I paid less that a hundred bucks and I didnt have to make an appointment I just walked in. Thime last place I went charged me $300 and she didn't get better even a little! I love this place and won't go anywhere else from now on!

I’m SO beyond happy I came here! Everyone was so kind and helpful! Having a new rescue who has disabilities, we were nervous bringing him into a new environment and everyone made us feel completely at ease and was able to help us w our new boy💕 please come here!!!

We have been using the Greenway PetWell Clinic for over a year now and have nothing but great experiences! Our most recent experience was for vaccines and, again, our fur baby was treated wonderfully by Dr Casey and Caitlin. We are incredibly grateful for the friendliness, thoroughness and gentle manner with our pup. Many thanks! We will be back.
The service was excellent and friendly, and no appointment was needed.

This clinic is amazing! The man at the front desk was so helpful, even though I was out of town. He helped me retrieve previous records and went out of his way. The vet was so sweet with my pup. I would definitely recommend!

Brought my pittbull in because he was having digestive issues. They were great with him!! They put him on antibiotics and even gave me a paper script so I could fill it at Costco. Overall, a great experience and grateful there was a clinic I could bring him too without notice. Highly recommend!

We have been customers of the Petwell clinics in the valley for two years. They are always friendly and helpful and very kind. Thank you, Dr. Casey for always being there for us. She is a great Veterinarian.

I absolutely love this veterinarian office! One of the biggest things that sets them apart is that they welcome walk-in and no appointment is necessary, which is a lifesaver when something unexpected comes up. The staff is always so kind, patient, and genuinely understanding. They really take the time to cater to both your pet’s needs and yours, and you can feel how much they care.

Their pricing also feels very fair for everyone involved, which I really appreciate. Honestly, the only “downside” is that I wish they were open every single day... that’s how great they are! Highly recommend this place for anyone

We had a “walk in” visit with our new kitten, she was sneezing constantly and was congested, the Doc (Casey) gave good advice and an antibiotic prescription. This took care of everything in two days, we are very pleased and grateful for the knowledge and professionalism.

We were surprised by how easy, convenient, and affordable it was to get our little dog's vaccines updated.  No wait, very clean, and the people were all kind, communicative, and knowledgeable.  We'll be back!
Dr. Eduardo is absolutely amazing. I could not have asked for a better vet for my fur babies. I am eternally grateful for his knowledge and sincerity. Thank you,  thank you, thank you 🙏❤️ …
Eduardo was amazing! Asked questions! And followed up two times after the visit by phone to see how Bob was doing! Recommended
Nice convenience having a walk in clinic. Wonderful, friendly staff. We got our MaltiPoo vaccinated there.

My large dog has an ear infection   He doesn't like to cooperate with doctors.. I put a muzzle on him and he was fine the staff took great care of him. They even gave him some bones afterwards since he did so good I will be taking my dog back there when a vet is needed.
The staff was very friendly and helpful.  When you call and leave a voice message, they quickly respond.
Great service, also very clean!
Hi, Pt. Thank you so much for rating your experience with us so highly!

Went there to get our kitty looked at - last minute appointment because out vet was closed.  Loved this place so much; the staff were lovely and the vet was so warm and kept our kitty very calm.  This is my new vet of choice!
I have two very anxious dogs that you handled expertly with kindness and compassion.  I so appreciate your approach to pet care.
I brought my big Pitbull Dolly in and the staff and vet were absolutely great with her. The price was affordable, we will definitely be going back.
Very compassionate and competent veterinarian and staff! When I arrived there was zero wait time and my baby was immediately seen. Prices were very reasonable.

I brought my cat here because it looked like she was starting to develop an eye infection. The staff was quick, kind, knowledgeable, and efficient! We were in and out in under 25 minutes and it was all about $100 for her exam and the antibiotic ointment for us to take home. Very convenient, we will be back :)

They’re awesome here honest and willing to answer any questions and concerns with honesty. Not upselling anything. Will continue to take my dog here. Thank you to Dr Eduardo and the front desk staff of course.

Love this place. I have never had a long wait, the staff is personable and competent. They don’t pressure me to spend money on excessive testing. They are reasonable and use common sense. My favorite vet so far!
My husband and I plus our fur babies love this vet location and Dr’s.  Would highly recommend.
Kind doctors, reasonable pricing, convenient hours, walk-in options, expert care…we are glad we found them!
PetWellClinic is not only very convenient but they have a great staff that cares about the animals they see. I have taken both of my dogs to this location for vaccines and check ups.
Hi, Shawn. Thank you so much for rating your experience with us so highly!

My baby Luna has always been treated at this location, and both she and I love everything about it (the front desk staff, the doctors, and the place itself). They're wonderful. Pure good energy. A clean clinic with a lot of knowledge.

Really like Dr Casey. Not an extremist. Gave my cat supportive care since could not find anything glaring. Thankfully he ended up fine within 36 hours without running up thousands of dollars in vet bills.
I never had to take him back in.  Sometimes animals just feel bad and they can’t tell us what it is and they just need a little time and a little support.

My nervous rescue pup needed a well visit and vaccines. This was the easiest visit for him! He stayed with me the whole time. We were taken straight to an exam room, and his care plan and payment options were very straightforward. The vet tech and vet were so friendly, caring, and thorough with my dog. I will be back next time he needs care!

My dog and I had a great experience here. With fear free handling, she was in and out fast, and staff was very helpful and caring. Their low cost prevention plans are available for cats and dogs offer necessary vaccines, office vist, ect. While schedules can vary weekly at all three clinics, care can be obtained Monday-Saturday.
If your pet has a minor illness, this is also a great option and walk ins are always available. You can register and check in on line to see wait times.  😀

Very friendly staff, walk-in without an appointment, fast service was in and out in about 30min, very budget friendly way less then expensive then an emergency vet. Thanks for taking care of my fur baby.
They are amazing and understanding
Hi, Niesmer. Thank you so much for rating your experience with us so highly!
I really liked it, she helped me by speaking Spanish and supported me in everything, the price was affordable, thank you very much.

I liked that I walked in and they took me right away.
they are kind and caring.
I would definitely recommend them!

I had a great experience at PetWell Clinic. Dr. Eduadeo, Caitlyn, and Nellie were all very professional, efficient, and kind. The visit was quick, affordable, and stress-free. I truly appreciate the care they provided and highly recommend this clinic to any pet owner looking for reliable and affordable veterinary services.
Hi, Sushama. Thank you so much for rating your experience with us so highly!
Always professional and glad to help. The vets and staff are very knowledgeable and put the pet first.
The staff was friendly and helpful, the service was prompt and thorough. And all at a reasonable price.
Hi, Stephanie. Thank you so much for rating your experience with us so highly!

I have a Labrador/Boxer mix and an American Staffordshire Terrier mix. My Labrador mix came in with inflammation, and my Staffordshire Terrier mix had severe itching and allergies.
The vet treated us like family. She loves animals, is excellent, and very professional. The place is very clean.

The price, including the visit and medication, is very affordable. And they accept walk-ins.

I highly recommend this place.
Great experience with PetWell Clinic.  We realized that our dog's rabies shot was due and they got us in right away.  Thanks Cole and the team!
Staff extremely friendly. Very clean.  Got us in right away.  Will definitely use again!
Excellent vets and service at a reasonable cost!!!
Hi, Tony. Thank you so much for rating your experience with us so highly!
Great service, easy and efficient.  Would recommend

I’ve seen Dr. Eduardo and Dr. Carrie at this vet practice. Both have been very professional, informative, and helpful. I like not having to make an appointment and their pricing is very reasonable. Also, this clinic is very clean and the office staff is efficient. Both of my cats were very calm during their office visits. The I would recommend taking your pet to PetWellClinic.
Showed my dog tons of love and made getting his vaccinations up to date quick and easy! :)
Convenient location, great prices, and staff was great!

Our kitty was very sick
They saw her immediately and communicated her needs . They were really helpful, compassionate, and gave good direction for her care
Thank you Dr Casey amd staff

Love that PetWell was walk-in and I didn’t have to wait for an appt. Especially as we got a new puppy and I wanted a health exam and vaccines asap. The staff from front desk to vet tech to the vet herself were all super nice, informative and made me feel at ease. They gave my puppy all his necessary shots, exam, trimmed his nails and microchipped him all within less than an hour. Also pricing for it all was extremely affordable. Highly recommend PetWell! Thank you for taking care of Churro & making me feel at ease with all my puppy concerns.

Our first first with our Australian Labradoodle was great ! She developed an ear hematoma and we were concerned. The staff and Dr Casey were awesome ! They tested Ans her ear yeast infection and all the scratching was the culprit and with meds she will get better want eh hematoma !
Dr Casey & staff were Caring ,kind & knowledgeable ! Petwell clinic will be our new vet clinic 100%
Great staff.   Focused on our dogs needs.
Hi, Diana. Thank you so much for rating your experience with us so highly!

I want everyone to be informed about valley fever. I hope it isn't too late on my part. My dog has had it unoticed for i dont know how long. Dr. Eduardo and his staff are the best. Please get your pets blood work done if you notice signs of valley fever.

We took in our 11 year old kitty, Max, who was having litterbox issues and just overall needed a senior workup and I cannot recommend this place enough! I wish we can take all of our animals here for primary care!! Dr Casey was extremely thorough and did an excellent job getting blood and urine from our kitty. He didn’t even make a peep! She even thought to check in his ears which we didn’t even think about. All of his tests including his exam fee was less than $350. My husband and I are extremely happy with our experience and will absolutely go back in the future when needed.

Never been so pleased, they got me in and out with positive feedback that my old vet didn’t do.
From now on PetWellClinic will be my go to vet also just a heads up my old vet wanted to charge me $500 plus and that wasn’t even with results from the lab and what they needed to do plus charge me more money. In and out at PetWellClinic problem solve and only cost me $144
Hi, Andrew. Thank you so much for rating your experience with us so highly!
Very friendly staff!  Easy walk-in or add to queue on website.

When my Shih Tzu was not eating and had a slight cough I decided to take her into the Pet Well Clinic because I wasn't sure if she had caught a virus. I'm visiting from out of town and was surprised to get in on last moment's notice. The staff was great and the price was very reasonable. Molly was ok, but it was nice to get her checked out anyway.

new 5-week old kitten was not eating and had an upper respiratory infection.  They prescribed antibiotics and showed me how to administer it.  Then they gave me a large plastic syringe and some prescription pet food and showed me how to squeeze a few drops into kitten's mouth to get him used to feeding.  After about 3 days the kitten started eating on its own.  Now he is ravenous and I have to be careful not to let him over-feed.  Pricing was very reasonable and staff was very friendly.  The business-model takes a little getting used to, there is no phone number where you can call in and speak to a receptionist.  However, you can just walk in any time or you can schedule an appointment online.
Friendly, knowledgeable and helpful staff, convenient hours and great prices for services. We all left happy and healthier!
Clean , beautiful clinic with very patient and loving vet and staff. We were helped right away and our little dog, Bella was much happier after treatment. Highly recommend this clinic.

I called PetWell Clinic several times yesterday and they didn’t answer my phone call.

The white female vet took the black receptionist/vet tech (I don't know her name.) away from our unfinished conversation, which was rude. The black receptionist/vet tech didn't inform the female vet that she hadn't finished our conversation, and then the lighted brown-skinned receptionist/vet (I don't know her first name.) jumped in and didn't know what was going on. She tried to grab the notes from me, and then the black receptionist/vet tech came back took the notes from me and showed them to another receptionist/vet. The black receptionist/vet went back to working with the female vet in another room, and then the light brown-skinned receptionist vet tech ignored me and focused on another customer who stood next to me and could speak and hear, which was wrong of her. I decided to walk away from PetWell Clinic and realized it was not worth wasting my money on them and didn't want to come back to it. I regret wasting my time and gas for this clinic and didn't get what I needed.

The receptionist/vet techs didn't show respect to me, but they showed their respect to customers who can hear and speak well. I feel the female vet doesn't care about a customer with a disability’s feelings.

They have no patience for people with disabilities.

One of the best places to take your pet, we had the best experience and everyone was so attentive, Dr. Gutierrez was so helpful and thorough and answered all our questions. They make it very affordable and easy to get your pet taken care of!

So many good things to say about PetWell. First of all it’s very affordable. Very affordable which is something someone like me who’s on a fixed income can appreciate. Now you’re probably thinking “oh, if it’s affordable to the lower class it can’t be that great“ right? Well you couldn’t be more mistaken. The staff was incredible. Everyone was very professional, polite, compassionate and didn’t hesitate to answer my questions of which I had many. It took me and Harley three buses to get there but it was totally worth it 😊
Hi, Randi. Thank you so much for rating your experience with us so highly!
Hi, M. Thank you so much for rating your experience with us so highly!
Wonderful clinic! Affordable and caring.

Took two dogs for shots on a Saturday morning. We walked right into an exam room when we arrived and only had to wait a few minutes for the vet to come in. The vet and tech were so good with our dogs. I would definitely go there again!

This place really was great: I needed a last minute appointment for my cat who was not feeling well. They were thorough and I got right in without an appt. If you need something quickly with kind practitioners you won't be disappointed!
Took our 2 month rescue puppy for her 1st puppy check up. Check in was quick and easy and very little wait time. The front staff and Vet were very friendly and gentle with the puppy.
Super fast and easy.   Got into a room right away and was out in less than a half hour.  Eased my worry and helped me be great pet parent . Thanks!!
PetWellClinic provided my dog fast, professional, excellent, affordable care! Everyone working there was pleasant and focused on the well being and experience of my dog! Thank you!
Thank you so much for taking the time to leave us a review, Manuel!
Sometimes I’m a little reluctant to leave reviews but this was such an amazing experience. The employees actually feel like they care about your pet and go the extra mile to provide care

The staff and Doctor at PetWellClinic took such great care of my Roxie. They are affordable and very knowledgable. Super easy too, we just walked in, no appointment necessary!  I highly recommend them!

I have taken my 2 1/2 year old standard goldendoodle to PetWell clinic 3 times. Every time has been extremely convenient and truly a great experience. An added plus is the ability to get in line prior to arrival. Each time, the wait has been minimal or no wait at all. I highly recommend PetWell Clinic.
